_comment: The cross-problem approach taxonomy. Every `mechanism` tag used in any problems/*/prior-art.json must be defined here with a field and a one-line description; tests/test_mechanisms.py enforces the sync. Query it with scripts/mechanisms.py (list / where / gaps / matrix). Descriptions are METHOD-level, never findings — findings live in attempt records and their leak_terms. This file is tier 1: blind agents never see it.
_fields_comment: `fields` is the lens vocabulary for cross-pollination. Each mechanism tag belongs to exactly one field. A field with no tags on a given problem is an untried lens there — that is what docs/IDEATE.md sweeps. Fields with zero tags anywhere are deliberately listed: they are the widest-open lenses.

fields.algebra: Group actions, symmetry, invariants, polynomial and ring structure.
fields.analysis: Real/complex analysis, generating functions, asymptotics, inequalities over the reals.
fields.computation: Exhaustive or structured search, enumeration infrastructure, exact arithmetic, SAT/solver methods.
fields.dynamics: Iteration, orbits, transfer operators, ergodic and symbolic-dynamics viewpoints.
fields.extremal-combinatorics: Extremal set systems and structures, shifting/compression, stability, local-global arguments.
fields.geometry-topology: Geometric, topological and lattice-point viewpoints; view-obstruction and covering-space framings.
fields.graph-theory: Structural graph theory: connectivity, girth, cycle structure, decompositions, minors.
fields.information-theory: Entropy, KL divergence, information inequalities and entropy-functional arguments.
fields.logic-methodology: Meta-level machinery: verification protocol, barrier maps, completeness arguments. Not itself an attack lens.
fields.number-theory: Congruences, quadratic residues, Diophantine equations, multiplicative structure.
fields.operator-theory: Spectral theory, numerical ranges, functional calculus, non-normal operator behaviour.
fields.probability: Random structures, couplings, dependence engineering, concentration, statistical modelling of exact data.

adversarial-verification.description: Skeptic pass whose default stance is refute: attack each claim of an existing record independently.

assumed-symmetry-construction.description: Assume a nontrivial automorphism group up front and search only for objects invariant under it, shrinking the search to the quotient.

aut-normalization.description: Quotient counts or searches by the automorphism group so symmetric objects are not over-weighted.

automorphism-order-restriction.description: Case-split on the possible orders of an automorphism and derive fixed-point/orbit constraints per case.

barrier-analysis.description: Map where and why a known technique provably stops, to direct later attempts around the obstruction.

basin-classification.description: Attribute each multi-start endpoint to a structure class via structural fingerprints and re-optimization probes, so landscape claims quantify basins rather than isolated values.

bitmask-backtracking.description: Depth-first search over labelings/assignments with bitset state for constant-time constraint checks.

block-adaptive-coupling.description: Couplings whose joint law is chosen per structural block of the instance rather than globally.

bounded-rank-laminate-screen.description: Enumerate every laminate tree topology up to a fixed rank over a finite normal set, optimise fractions in floating point as a screen, then certify winners exactly.

branch-and-bound.description: Depth-first search with a bound that prunes any branch whose best completion cannot beat the incumbent.

bridge-block-analysis.description: Decompose near-counterexamples by bridges/2-connected blocks to locate where the required structure lives.

c-kernel.description: Hot inner loop reimplemented as a small C program driven by a Python harness.

canonical-cell-enumeration.description: Partition the search domain into canonical cells enumerated exactly once, giving a completeness guarantee.

carmichael-pairwise-constraint.description: Use pairwise divisibility conditions of Carmichael/Giuga type (p | prod(others) - 1) as a filter while building prime sets.

cayley-graph-ball-search.description: Search a group's Cayley graph by growing balls around the identity and testing the induced structure at each radius.

certified-box-coverage.description: Cover a parameter region by boxes on which a claim is certified by exact or validated arithmetic, and treat the geometry of the uncovered remainder as a first-class deliverable.

certified-enclosure.description: Turn a float optimization endpoint into a proven bound by rounding to a rational point and certifying the objective there with rigorous directed-rounding enclosures.

certified-interval-inequality.description: Prove a one-variable analytic inequality rigorously by splitting into an endpoint-algebra zone, an adaptive rational-interval bisection zone, and a derivative-sign zone near a vanishing endpoint; all enclosures exact-rational, single evaluations only.

chain-rule-assembly.description: Assemble a per-coordinate entropy chain-rule sum into a family-level certificate, tracking the conditional mutual-information terms the assembly must pay.

character-block-decomposition.description: Decompose the adjacency action over the characters of a cyclic automorphism group so eigenvalue multiplicities of the graph split into quotient and character-block parts, constraining the orbit matrix's spectrum and trace.

chromatic-number-search.description: Compute or bound the chromatic number of a finite graph exactly, typically with backtracking and symmetry-aware ordering.

class-enrichment.description: Test whether a distinguished class of instances is statistically enriched or impoverished for a property.

class-restricted-minima.description: Track extremal values within structural subclasses, not just globally, to see which class carries the extremum.

closed-form-last-two.description: Solve for the final two entries of a multiplicative-constraint sequence in closed form once the prefix is fixed, instead of searching them.

closed-form-parameterization.description: Turn a numerically located optimum into exact closed-form parameters by imposing the constraints symbolically, solving the residual freedom exactly, then pattern-matching the solved values across instances and re-checking exactly.

coated-assemblage-attainability.description: Coat each inclusion phase separately by a matrix phase with core fractions tuned to a common effective value, and read off the parameter region where the construction is feasible.

collision-search.description: Hash or sort a generated set to find repeated values (coincidences) rather than testing pairs.

compass-closure.description: Close a point set under unit-distance constructions (intersections of unit circles) to generate candidate rigid configurations.

completeness-argument.description: Prove the enumeration covered everything in range, so absence of hits is a theorem about the range.

conditionally-iid.description: Model dependent pairs as iid conditional on a latent variable, to interpolate between iid and adversarial.

constraint-propagation-search.description: Search with forced-assignment propagation after each choice so local contradictions surface before branching.

coupling.description: Construct a joint distribution with prescribed marginals so a quantity of interest becomes comparable pathwise.

critical-subgraph-extraction.description: Strip vertices from a witness while a property is preserved, to isolate a minimal certificate.

cycle-spectrum.description: Compute the full set of cycle lengths per graph and reason about which spectra are realizable.

difference-set-autocorrelation.description: Encode a graph on a group by a connection set and test regularity conditions through the set's autocorrelation counts.

duality-reduction.description: Use an exact duality (here Keller-Dykhne) to map one side of a two-sided problem onto the other at transformed parameters, halving what a census must compute.

eigenvalue-projector-prune.description: Prune an equitable-quotient search by requiring the leading blocks of the eigenvalue projectors (congruent integer forms) to be PSD with bounded rank.

entropy-functional-reweighting.description: Replace Shannon entropy by a reweighted or penalized functional and re-derive the base inequality.

entropy-method.description: Gilmer-style argument: bound the entropy of a combined random object against the entropies of its parts.

exact-feasibility-arithmetic.description: Decide feasibility of a combinatorial configuration in exact integer/rational arithmetic rather than floating point.

exact-field-arithmetic.description: Represent coordinates in an explicit number field so distance equalities are decided exactly.

exact-rational-arithmetic.description: Certified exact computation over Q (fractions, directed rounding, rigorous enclosures) replacing floating point in verification, so that a numeric claim becomes a rational identity or a certified inequality.

exact-rational-ml.description: Exact rational arithmetic for extremal quantities, so ties and strict inequalities are decided without float error.

exhaustive-enumeration.description: Generate every object in a finite range and test the property directly.

exhaustive-labeling-count.description: Count all valid labelings per object exactly, not just decide existence.

exhaustive-small-family-search.description: Brute-force all instances at tiny size to anchor conjectured constants and find minimal examples.

exhaustive-speed-tuple-scan.description: Enumerate all parameter tuples to a bound, with symmetry reduction, and evaluate the objective on each.

field-equality-analysis.description: Read off what a variational bound's equality case demands of the pointwise fields, then measure those demands on candidate structures as independent defect channels.

field-lens-sweep.description: Cross-field ideation sweep: apply untried field lenses to one problem in parallel to generate candidate attack routes; output is a MAP of triaged leads and recorded no-purchase verdicts (docs/IDEATE.md).

forcing-gadget-search.description: Look for small subgraphs whose colourings are forced, to be glued into larger graphs that push the chromatic number.

formal-parameter-specialization.description: Prove an infinite family of identities at one stroke by moving the family parameters into the exponent lattice: adjoin e^{i a alpha}, e^{i b beta} (or analogous parameter-indexed units) as independent formal Laurent variables, verify the identity once by exact polynomial subtraction in the enlarged ring, and specialize by ring homomorphism to every integer parameter value. Turns a hand geometric-series computation into a finite machine check; needs a short hand derivation that the geometric quantities equal the formal closed forms.

functional-graph-invariants.description: Compute unlabelled structural invariants -- dominator tree, minimum directed cuts, treewidth -- on the digraph of an iterated map, and test whether any carries information the map does not already give. On a functional graph (out-degree one everywhere) the answer is usually no, and the collapse is provable rather than measured: unique forward orbits force the dominator tree to be the orbit tree, and one cycle plus a forest forces constant treewidth. Prices a graph-theoretic route before the machinery is built; the collapse is the deliverable.

girth-restriction.description: Restrict the search to high-girth instances, where short-cycle escapes are unavailable and structure is forced.

giuga-sequences.description: Study the integer sequences built by the defining Giuga-type recurrence rather than only their prime realisations.

gram-mass-pairing.description: Recast an averaged inequality as a Frobenius pairing of a PSD Gram mass matrix against a deficit matrix, so spectral conditions on the deficit decide the bound and their failure modes locate counterexamples.

group-homomorphism-barrier.description: Show a construction family cannot succeed by exhibiting a homomorphism to a small group that colours or caps it.

group-orbit-enumeration.description: Reduce a combinatorial search universe by a finite symmetry group: enumerate canonical orbit representatives and verify completeness against Burnside counts.

hierarchical-laminate-construction.description: Build effective tensors of iterated (multi-rank) laminates as exact rational functions of fractions, directions and phase constants; attainment of a bound becomes an equality in Q.

implicit-function-theorem.description: Existence/uniqueness/smoothness of implicitly-defined objects (fixed points, scaling potentials) in a parameter, with quantitative resolvent bounds.

independent-reimplementation.description: Re-derive a computational claim with different code and, where possible, a different algorithm.

interval-chain-covering.description: Prove an existence statement by covering the target interval with an overlapping chain of parametric rational intervals, reducing the claim to elementary endpoint inequalities with a constructive floor-formula witness.

isomorph-rejection.description: Canonical-form or invariant-based rejection of isomorphic copies during enumeration.

k-wise-union.description: Generalize a two-element union/combination argument to k-wise combinations and track how constants move.

lex-leader-symmetry-breaking.description: Keep only the lex-maximal representative under adjacent transpositions of interchangeable objects, checked on decided positions during the search.

literature-reconciliation.description: Reconcile an internal finding with the published record: locate the corresponding published claim, check whether it agrees, and record attribution chains and transcription caveats rather than smoothing them.

local-model-swarm.description: Farm drafts, skeptic passes and ideation to a locally served open-weight model as a third worker family, calibrating every return before use.

local-structure-reduction.description: Derive forced local structure (neighbourhood shape, partner counts) from the parameters and encode it before searching.

machine-checked-formalization.description: State a skeptic-confirmed proof step in a proof assistant (Lean 4 + mathlib) and have the kernel accept a sorry-free proof; the informal-to-formal statement bridge is reviewed separately per docs/FORMALIZE.md.

mordell-qr-obstruction.description: Use quadratic-residue conditions to characterize which residue classes a covering-congruence argument can reach.

mutual-information-tax.description: Bound the conditional mutual information a dependent coupling spends against the per-coordinate entropy gains it buys; the route survives iff gains exceed the tax.

nauty-geng.description: Canonical isomorph-free graph generation via nauty/geng as the enumeration backbone.

nonsmooth-maximization.description: Locally maximize a nonsmooth (norm/eigenvalue/max-type) objective with derivative-free methods, using an explicit escape-probe test to separate genuine local maxima from optimizer stalls.

odd-giuga-number.description: Restrict the search to the odd case and exploit the parity and size constraints specific to it.

optimization-landscape-census.description: Map the local-maximum landscape of an objective by multi-start local optimization from designed start families, classifying every endpoint rather than reporting only the best value.

orbit-matrix-search.description: Enumerate quotient (orbit) matrices of a presumed automorphism and try to lift each to a full object.

out-of-sample-prediction.description: Test a conjectured law on family members it was not fitted to, computed before comparison, so that agreement is evidence and disagreement is refutation rather than refitting.

overlap-tilt.description: Bias a joint distribution toward structurally overlapping pairs while preserving the marginals.

parity-argument.description: Derive constraints from parity or 2-adic valuation of the defining conditions.

periodic-colouring-cap.description: Bound the chromatic number of a lattice-generated set from above by an explicit periodic colouring.

perturbative-expansion.description: Expand a functional around an exactly-solved point (product measure, equality case) and control the remainder with explicit second-order budgets.

plackett.description: Plackett-family copulas: one-parameter odds-ratio control of dependence with fixed marginals.

pollard-rho-factorisation.description: Factor auxiliary integers with a deterministic Pollard-rho/Brent routine with an explicit give-up bound.

polynomial-identities.description: Parametric algebraic identities that settle every instance in a residue class at once.

positive-control-calibration.description: Run the search on a known instance with the same parameters to check it can find what is known before trusting a negative.

prime-set-enumeration.description: Enumerate sets of primes satisfying a divisibility/reciprocal-sum constraint by ordered extension.

randomised-construction.description: Sample constructions at random from a constrained family and keep those passing an exact check.

rational-function-reconstruction.description: Recover a symbolic rational function from exactly-computed samples: solve the homogeneous linear system num(x_i) - y_i den(x_i) = 0 over Q at the smallest total degree with a one-dimensional null space, validate on points not used in the fit, factor the denominator by exact deflation of conjectured roots, then fit the remaining shape numbers against the other variables and re-verify the assembled formula as an identity.

reciprocal-sum-relaxation.description: Relax the exact divisibility conditions to the reciprocal-sum inequality and bound the object through the relaxation.

representation-count-mining.description: Compute exact representation/solution counts per instance and mine the table for structural patterns.

representation-count-statistics.description: Treat exact counts as a dataset: normalize for size, then test which structural covariates explain the variance.

residue-class-covering.description: Cover all instances by congruence classes, each settled by its own identity or argument.

row-inner-product-pruning.description: Fill a symmetric constrained matrix row by row and bound each partial row against the linear equations its inner products with completed rows must satisfy.

schur-complement-sharpness.description: At an equality point of a bound the gap's gradient vanishes, so the leading gap over a parameterised class is the Schur complement of the gap's Hessian with respect to the free parameters. Enlarging the class can only lower it, and a direction with zero coupling to the constraint variable cannot move it at all -- so 'does a richer class do better?' becomes finite exact linear algebra at one point.

sensitivity-kernel-design.description: Design adversarial instances from the non-positive-semidefinite directions of a weight kernel: when a candidate functional is a kernel-weighted Gram form, scan the kernel for PSD failures and realize the violating configuration in an actual measure.

sign-constant-progression-pigeonhole.description: Exclude higher rotation branches by pigeonhole: if every term of an arithmetic progression of angles (step < half-period) has the same sinusoid sign, all terms lie in one sign component, bounding the progression's total span by the component length; a hypothesis forcing endpoints into different components is contradictory. Turns families of trig-margin inequalities with a lattice structure into one span bound, replacing per-case interval estimates.

simulated-annealing-construction.description: Local search with an annealing schedule on a penalty counting violated regularity conditions.

sinkhorn.description: Sinkhorn/IPF scaling to construct or normalize couplings with prescribed marginals numerically.

size-normalized-selection.description: Compare instances against size-matched controls so magnitude effects are not read as structural effects.

slice-parallelism.description: Split an enumeration into independent restartable slices with per-slice checkpoint files.

smoothing-insensitive-functional.description: Study functionals unchanged by small-mass smoothing of the law, and what any such functional can or cannot see.

spectrum-gap-analysis.description: Examine the set of achieved objective values for gaps and accumulation points, not just the extremum.

structural-reduction.description: Reduce the problem to a smaller structured one by fixing forced components before searching.

structure-class-design-search.description: Invert a proven structural mechanism into a design tool: parametrize the structure class the mechanism applies to, enumerate the class, derive each member's governing invariant (symbolically where the mechanism factors, numerically where it does not), and hunt for members whose invariant lands in a target range.

symbolic-trig-closed-form.description: Recast an iterated geometric construction in an exact division-free symbolic domain (here Laurent polynomials in half-angle exponentials over Q(i)) so that the quantities of interest become closed-form trigonometric polynomials whose factorizations expose the law being sought.

tangency-curvature-ratio.description: When a bound is met exactly at a boundary point of the region where it is disputed, replace the search over the region by a ratio of second derivatives at that point: check the meeting is first-order tangential, then compare curvatures. Turns 'how far below does the family sit?' into two exactly computable numbers.

tightness-census.description: Enumerate all near-extremal instances in range to see whether tightness is isolated or part of a family.

total-positivity.description: TP2/MTP2 and log-supermodularity structure: four-function and Cauchy-Schwarz cross-ratio inequalities, closure under conditioning and marginalization.

triangular-lattice-rotation.description: Build unit-distance point sets as unions of rotated copies of the triangular lattice.

unfolding-word-census.description: Enumerate symbolic bounce words, reduce them by symmetry, and certify periodic billiard orbits by unfolding each word to a translation and intersecting the resulting corridor over a parameter box.

unit-distance-graph-census.description: Enumerate unit-distance graphs on a structured point set and tabulate their invariants against a parameter.

up-sets.description: Reduce to monotone (upward-closed) families and exploit correlation/shifting structure available there.

variational-equality-case.description: Turn the slack in a variational bound into an exact identity in the trial-field deviations, so the gap decomposes into named, separately measurable terms.

volume-product-census.description: Enumerate convex bodies over a structured vertex universe and compute Mahler volume products, with exact rational recomputation near the extremum and explicit equality-case certificates.

weighted-kl.description: Replace entropy differences by c-weighted KL divergences to a reference law and tune c.
